statement.zh: **攻击**：一次性密码本重用（One-Time Pad Reuse）。一次性密码本重用是同一密钥流被用于加密多条消息。
statement.en: **Attack**: One-Time Pad Reuse (一次性密码本重用).One-time pad reuse is the use of the same keystream to encrypt more than one message.

statement.zh: HAC 指出密钥流重用会提供攻击途径。按“输入 → 状态 → 变换 → 输出 → 判据”复述机制；每一步都要能指出谁执行、改变什么、留下什么证据。无法指出证据的步骤，只能标为待核，不能写成已复现。
statement.en:
HAC states that reusing the key string provides ways to attack the system.### Mechanism check

Restate the chain as input → state → transform → output → criterion.

statement.zh: 重用两个密文的异或会消除密钥流，留下两个明文的异或。
statement.en: XORing two ciphertexts produced under the same keystream cancels the keystream and leaves the XOR of the two plaintexts.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 一次性密码本要求密钥随机选择且永不重用；重用会破坏其理论不可破性。
statement.en:
The one-time pad requires a randomly chosen key that is never reused; reuse breaks its theoretical unbreakability.### Formal model

Adv_A = Pr[Succ_A] − Pr[Succ_ideal]；Cost = D × T × M；Success = 1[advantage > threshold].
